text: A phone that rings for no one. The lantern is lit.
picture: The Storyteller stands in a profound, cavernous darkness, his form defined only by the crimson light of the lantern he holds aloft. His face is half-lit, shadowed by the lantern's glow, wearing the calm, eerie stillness of a guide to the underworld. Mist curls around his ankles.
motion: slow subtle movement: the figure breathes and shifts, chalk dust drifts

text: I work nights at the Calder Road call centre. At 3:07, line nine lit up. Line nine was disconnected years ago.
picture: Nadia sits at one desk in a vast, pitch-black call centre. Her face is dimly lit by her monitor, her expression weary but alert. In the sea of dark phone consoles, only one button glows a deep, warning red on line nine.
motion: slow subtle movement: the figure breathes and shifts, chalk dust drifts
sound: a low, persistent hum of electronics

text: I answered anyway. A woman's voice whispered, "You left the back door open."
picture: Nadia holds a phone receiver to her ear, her face starkly lit from below by the monitor, her eyes widened in dawning horror, lips slightly parted. The red glow from line nine is reflected in her glasses.
motion: slow subtle movement: the figure breathes and shifts, chalk dust drifts

text: I live alone. I opened my security camera. The back door was open, and the kitchen light was on.
picture: A grainy, green-tinted view from a high security camera. It shows a dark, empty kitchen. The overhead light is on, illuminating a counter and a cup, and the back door is unmistakably ajar, opening onto impenetrable blackness outside.
motion: slow subtle movement: the figure breathes and shifts, chalk dust drifts
sound: the faint buzz of the camera feed

text: Some calls are better left unanswered. Would you have picked up?
picture: The Storyteller has lowered his lantern slightly, its crimson light now mostly illuminating the ground at his feet. He looks directly at the viewer, his expression a mask of somber warning. The surrounding darkness seems to press closer.
motion: slow subtle movement: the figure breathes and shifts, chalk dust drifts
